*F-bsig* (Blind signature) is part of *Layer 7: Privacy and Anonymity* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Fischlin. [*Round-optimal composable blind signatures in the common reference string model*](https://iacr.org/archive/crypto2006/41170058/41170058.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2006, 2006.
- Abe and Ohkubo. [*A framework for universally composable non-committing blind signatures*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2009/494). International Journal of Applied Cryptography, 2(3):229–249, 2012.
